lines: Nor is it to-be-said in-someone-just man descent:
he just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines.
In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name —
l4.sanskrit_cite: na ca vācyaṃ kasmāt kasmiṃścid eva puṃsi śaktipāta iti sa eva parameśvaraḥ tathā bhāti iti satattve ko 'sau pumān nāma yaduddeśena viṣayakṛtā codanā iyam

reads_against.argmap: Why is śaktipāta not said of some man? → The 'man' of śaktipāta collapses into parameśvara: pumān is codanā-viṣayakṛtā, a name-purport, not a substrate.
c1_essence: Śaktipāta is not of some man: he just is the Supreme-Lord — pumān is purport-impulse, not substrate.
